digest.component_or_area: Configuration and credential access control (RP-04 / S7)
propositions: No direct ambient configuration or credential reads, backend reloads, or configurable adapter defaults are permitted outside approved composition seams
A deterministic AST ownership gate must map every declared configuration and credential name to exactly one approved owner and reject any unowned new registry entries
The ownership gate and existing field-consumption gate must both execute in make lint and CI pipelines with parity verification to prevent silent omission
Generated configuration precedence, security lifecycle, and operator documentation must be byte-current with the authoritative schema and ownership registries
Legacy facades and per-job ambient read paths must be removed only after their focused test suites, behavioral oracles, and bounded live canaries pass with redacted evidence
Migration exceptions are shrink-only and must be empty before contract-phase legacy removal; rollback below the S1 snapshot-envelope floor is unsupported
